d:
Ek bharat shreshth bharat- kya aapne dekhi hai jharkhand ki kala men chhipi sanskriti aur paranpraon ki anokhi duniya? dekhie jharkhand ke chitrakla aur shilpakla par ek vritchitr | DD JHARKHAND
Kya divaron par bani chitrakari bhi kisi samaj ki kahani kah sakti hai? kya mitti, bans, lakri aur dhatu se bani kalakritiyon men hamari sanskriti aur itihas ki jhalak mil sakti hai? jharkhand ki paranprik chitrakla aur shilpakla men aise hi kaee rang, kahaniyan aur paranpraen chhipi hain.
